items.title: Stable cohomology ring of universal PGL character varieties is freely generated by generalized kappa classes
items.author: Ishan Banerjee; Faye Jackson; Anne Larsen; Sam Payne; Xiyan Zhong
items.difficulty_reason: The explicit polynomial stable-ring theorem requires relative nonabelian Hodge comparison, Hodge-module purity/splitting and Leray-Serre degeneration, symplectic monodromy/local-system computations, fiber cohomology generators/relations and a scanning/Madsen-Weiss comparison identifying the generalized kappa-class ring map in the exact stable range. Original g,n>=2, coprime component d and degree bound s(g) preserved. Old monodromy-action proposition is support, not the stable universal-character-variety ring calculation. SL/GL and intersection-cohomology extensions retained without extra counts.

primary.label: Complete original stable polynomial cohomology-ring theorem and exact kappa-class map

proof_spans.label: Complete universal nonabelian-Hodge, purity/splitting, Leray-Serre, monodromy/stable computations and scanning/ring proof chain

contexts.label: Original universal PGL character variety, g/n/d hypotheses, stable range, graded generators and tautological bundle conventions
Original SL/GL extensions, tables and proof roadmap retained uncounted
Original intersection-cohomology appendix and extensions retained uncounted
